name: Tamamo
source: A self-proclaimed nine-tailed-fox that recently began haunting the protagonist. Her powers seem to have disappeared, and though she's stuck in this miniature body, she's apparently a powerful spirit from hundreds of years ago. She's got an innocent personality...well, she's actually a bit of an idiot.
